show.name: Большое шоу
show.summary: This is Azamat Musagaliyev's Big Show! Ten famous people are competing for a cash prize. The task is simple - DO NOT LAUGH! Who fails - out of the game. The last one, gets everything.

show.name: Айда!
show.summary: Grisha, a teenager from a privileged family, moves from Volgograd to Kazan and finds himself in the epicenter of a street gang war. He is a stranger in this world, but in order to survive, he has to learn its cruel rules. Zakharevich, the ideologue of the Tyap-Lyap gang, becomes an unexpected mentor for him. He is an intelligent, educated and ambitious manipulator who created a system for dragging teenagers into organized crime. The only one who is aware of the impending threat is the head of the criminal investigation department Nikonov. It will take time for him to understand that this is not just a criminal outburst, behind which there are non-ordinary figures, but the beginning of large-scale processes capable of destroying the country.

show.name: История его служанки
show.summary:
Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt.

 Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.

show.name: Красота
show.summary: The end of the 80s, a time of change and high hopes. Vera, the director of the House of Culture, launches the country's first beauty contest, despite the displeasure of officials. But against the background of the collapse of the country, it is under threat of closure — the country has no money for beauty. In an attempt to find a solution, Vera makes a deal with criminals, falling into a dangerous trap.

show.name: Тяжелый люкс
show.summary: Ksenia is the wife of a wealthy real estate developer, living in a world of luxury brands, exclusive clubs, and a constant struggle for status. She desperately tries to fit in among the women of Rublevka, but after a tragic accident, she finds herself drawn into the underground market for elite "pali."

show.name: Against the Sky Supreme
show.summary: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

show.name: Cang Yuan Tu
show.summary: The story tells the story of Meng Chuan, the protagonist, who has made a vow to avenge his mother's death since he was a child and takes the Mirror Lake Daoist College as his starting point. With his resolute and fearless heart and decisive sword skills, he punishes the evil, destroys the demons, ascends to the top of the four Daoist Colleges, becomes famous in the Dongning Province, pays homage to the Yuanchu Mountain, and achieves a generation of gods and demons.(DeepL)

show.name: Her Willing Subject
show.summary: Regent Lu Qingcang and Empress Shen Shuying once divided the realm, ruler against ruler—yet the Yin-Yang Gu bound them to a shared fate of life and death. Manipulated by schemers, they perished together. Both reborn, they resume their bitter rivalry. Step by step, through political bloodshed and emotional tug-of-war, they unravel misunderstandings, learn to coexist and love, and join forces to break the game—transforming from hostile rivals into equals in love.

show.name: The Sound of Sugar Cubes
show.summary: An orphan, Han Yul didn't have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Han Yul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?

show.name: Francesca Next Door
show.summary: Na Yeong, the vampire transfer student from Romania. Zero social skills, zero common sense, but also zero malice. Although Na Yeong has clear standards and logic, she cannot adapt to the human world and constantly goes astray and causes trouble at school, but upon meeting U Ju, she feels the emotion of a racing heart for the first time. A young vampire who falls in love with a human, and a fellow vampire who stirs her instincts; a sweet yet deadly romance of youths wavering between love and instinct.

show.name: The Legend of Luoxiaohei
show.summary: The story started from a rainy night, a homeless little black cat was brought home by a young girl Luo Xiaobai, that girl named the cat "Luo Xiaohei". LXH is not an ordinary cat, it can use the closestool well but doesn't eat cat food, its long tail can be splited into multiple organisms call "Heixiu" . On the other hand, a mystery role called "Diting" now is commanding his henchmen three wolfs with wings to search for LXH. When Xiaobai bring LXH to the countryside, she finally found that Xiaohei made her involved in a variety of bizarre fantasy events...

show.name: Fox Spirit Matchmaker
show.summary: Buy UCO from childhood grew up in the clan, Ichigo, but their "care" was for him a living Hell. Constant bullying, stealing the Goodies, without which Ycu can not live, and even eternal persecution, from the fair sex turned him into a goner cheapskate who wants to take revenge on his tormentors. But revenge is sweet and the path to it is thorny and to accomplish, UCU need to marry a girl Yes, as soon as possible. But when the heroes just happen? Never! And meeting with the small and the big-eared Fox Susan su su did not just destroy his plans, but starts spinning the wheel of fate that was waiting in the wings for hundreds of years!

show.name: Silent Echoes
show.summary: In 2011, a murder case occurs at Jiugu Lake in Xiping City. Detective Ma Xuesong and rookie female officer Meng Wen begin investigating and discover the case is linked to the disappearance of Luo Xue, involving multiple parties including the Deli Group. As more murders surface, a criminal network involving drugs, money laundering, and abuse gradually comes to light. Throughout the investigation, the two draw closer to the truth while each undergoes their own growth and trials.

show.name: Blossom in Darkness
show.summary: The play is adapted based on Guoguo's novel of the same name. Big Demon Qi Fengyin (acted by Li Hongyi), born out of evil thoughts, is locked in the Panic Mountain Barrier due to his killing of the mortals and immortals a thousand years ago. The small Medicine Spirit Yamao (acted by Sun Zhenni), transformed from the herb Huanyangcao, is chased by all sorts of people due to its magic physique and happens to break in the barrier, leading Qi Fengyin's failure to have a human body and his evil thoughts fly. Since then, the two have had a deep bond and have experienced all kinds of stories together.

show.summary: Su Yunian infiltrates the glittering, decadent world of "The Heart of Opulence" to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, only to be swept into a deadly power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jiasheng. She soon learns her sister was silenced for possessing crucial evidence. As danger mounts, betrayed by her closest friend, framed by the top courtesan, and relentlessly pursued by Nie Feng, Su Yunian walks a razor's edge between enmity and alliance with Tu Jiasheng. In this realm of illusions, every glimmer hides a blood-stained lie.

show.name: Taming the Husband
show.summary: Jin Bao Zhu, the spirited daughter of a butcher, has always harbored simple, materialistic dreams of wealth and comfort. Desperate to escape her oppressive family life, she volunteers to enter a prestigious canal transport family as the concubine of their son, Xie Yan. However, her dreams of luxury quickly shatter: while Xie Yan was once a brilliant prodigy, he has been left disabled and disgraced by a tragic accident. Xie Yan has become bitter and self-destructive and resents Bao Zhu, who he feels has been forced upon him. The marriage gets off to a rough start, as Xie Yan and Bao Zhu are constantly fighting. But as they navigate the treacherous political schemes surrounding the canal transport industry and fend off ambitious relatives, their mutual animosity slowly transforms. Can they find a way to work together to save their crumbling family legacy and their marriage?

Phoenix Rising from the Faint Moon
show.summary: Feng Weiyue, a modern-day dimensional research team leader, has an accidents during a space experiment and transmigrates to the Yinbei Dynasty together with her colleague Ye Changjiu and her boss Jun Qingye. Feng Weiyue wakes up in the body of the Grand Tutor's legitimate daughter, only to find herself in the bedchamber of the Prince of Rong, Mo Yuya, stuck with the dreadful reputation of a "boy-crazy princess consort". Meanwhile, Mo Yuya is being constantly targeted for assassination by Gu Nanke, the master of the Xingzhao Pavilion. Feng Weiyue unexpectedly discovers that she shares a tangled connection with Gu Nanke, and the dimensional bracelet she brought through time becomes her ultimate cheat code.

show.summary: Welcome to Bablo, the world's best library!

body.name: Slap kabaddi
body.summary: Grown men slap each other with all their might in "slap kabaddi," a popular combat sport in Pakistan. Kristoffer Olsen and Nicolay give it everything they've got.

show.name: Helt Ramme sporter
show.summary: From acrobatic football-volleyball in Malaysia to the World Championship in eating fries in Canada. Nicolay Ramm brings four of Norways bravest celebs out in the world. Here they will try to become the best in some of the worlds weridest sports.

show.name: My Chef in Crime
show.summary: Forensic scientist-turned-chef Chan becomes the prime suspect in his rival chef's mysterious death. He must clear his name, using his deep knowledge of food chemistry and forensic science, and teaming up with fearless investigative police officer Lieutenant Lalit whose past intertwines with his own. Together, they tackle intriguing cases through culinary experiments and create mouth-watering dishes.

body.name: Bløfferen
body.summary: Despite hidden agendas, the participants insist that they are only telling the truth, yet there is no doubt that many could be called the biggest bluffer.

show.name: Bløff
show.summary: In a fairytale castle, ten contestants compete against each other in a game that isn't about how smart you are, but about how smart people think you are.

body.name: The Landfriend
body.summary:
When Bill's wife walks out on him for the gardener, he's left lonely and broke. In the hope of turning his life around, he lets out his spare rooms to four students.

Bill is thrilled to meet his new housemates: Christian, Zahra, Hettie, and James. But when Christian keeps leaving the fridge door open, Bill has to come up with a scheme to get it shut without ruining his image as a relaxed, fun landlord.

Bill's best mate, Drew, gives him the idea to deploy an anonymous suggestions box, but this backfires when the students' requests lead to the worst night's sleep of his life. Bill's neighbour and secret crush, Siobhan, suggests sending over her intimidating husband, Martin, to complain on Bill's behalf, but when this ruse is exposed, Bill fears the students will leave him, just like his wife did.

He's grateful to learn that not only do they have nowhere else to live but they forgive him, since university is all about starting over. For better or worse, his new life truly has begun.

show.name: Bill's Included
show.summary:
Bill's Included follows Bill Beam, a well meaning but over enthusiastic divorcee who rents his spare rooms to students to stay afloat.

As Bill tries - and often fails to be both responsible landlord and honorary housemate, he and his mismatched lodgers muddle through chaos, growing pains and unexpected friendships.

body.name: The Nickname
body.summary: Bill's exciting new life comes crashing down when he learns that his lodgers have given themselves nicknames but left him out. Hurt, Bill ramps up his eccentricities in the hope of providing the inspiration for a new moniker, only for his odd behaviour to confirm the students' suspicion that they're living with a weirdo.

show.name: Bill's Included
show.summary:

As Bill tries - and often fails to be both responsible landlord and honorary housemate, he and his mismatched lodgers muddle through chaos, growing pains and unexpected friendships.

body.name: The Rival
body.summary:
Bill is thrilled to have been included in group watchalongs of the students' TV obsession, House of Keys. So when Hettie suggests they have a party for the series finale, Bill is on cloud nine and happily offers to run the lodgers into town for various errands.

But when the favours start to add up, he realises he is being taken advantage of and experiments with saying ‘no' - which frees his schedule for DIY hobbies. Meanwhile, Zahra challenges Christian's claims that he knows how to do laundry, and Hettie agrees to her boyfriend's suggestion of an open relationship.

Bill's firm boundaries with the lodgers backfires when they meet smug PhD student Marcus, who starts giving them lifts to campus and fixing all their problems big and small, and Bill feels replaced as the house's wise font of wisdom.

body.name: The Date
body.summary:
When Bill finds out that his ex-wife Anne and the gardener she ran off with are planning to marry, he realises that he should move on romantically too. So he asks Christian to help him join dating apps, who insists Bill presents an idealised version of himself through a series of white lies about his intellectual credentials.

Meanwhile, Hettie is frustrated that her boyfriend Nathan doesn't appreciate how much their open relationship is upsetting her, so she plans to ‘fake flirt' with James in front of him at a club night.

body.name: The Blues
body.summary: It's the morning after the group's calamitous night out, and the house is tense. Whilst Hettie and James try to work out who Nathan snogged, a guilt-stricken Zahra agonises over whether to come clean that it was her. Christian unhelpfully revels in the drama, whilst the hungover Bill has no clue about the unfolding intrigue and laments that the lodgers are so on edge.

body.name: The Replacement
body.summary:
Bill responds to the twist of Siobhan's move abroad with the emotional crutch of a new sports car. But when the students rib him for splurging their rent, he claims that his uncle gave him the car, a lie that is immediately put under stress by the news that Hettie is moving into halls. But, without her rent, Bill can't afford the car's monthly payments.

Bill scrambles to find a new tenant, but when the university's accommodation office provides only dreadful candidates that the other students reject, he's forced into drastic action. Dropping Hettie off on campus, he gets the idea to appear on the popular TikTok hotspots, advertising the spare room to a big student audience.

body.name: Episode 5
body.summary:
When the body of a windsurfer washes ashore on Beadnell Bay, Rose and Joe are pulled into a murky case involving the intertwined worlds of funerals, windsurfing and dangerous spiked cigarettes.

The victim is identified as Andrew Bilton, stepson to Bev Bilton, a stern funeral director who quickly becomes suspect number one after Rose and Raj discover underlying resentments between her and her stepson. Complicating matters further, Bev is locked in an intense feud with Kass Moberly, a vibrant young funeral director who was secretly seeing Andrew before his death. As the investigation deepens, further tangled up in the case are Bev's shifty deputy manager, Alfie, and Andrew's tight-knit windsurfing crew, Noah and Chatri, who seem to be hiding secrets of their own.

Meanwhile, Joe launches his own off-the-books investigation into a local group of teenagers getting high at the priory, deeply concerned for their safety. What begins as a side project soon intersects directly with Rose's murder case, revealing a shocking connection between the spiked cigarettes circulating among the youth and Andrew's unpleasant death.

Joining forces once again, Rose and Joe must navigate a muddle of illicit drug dealing, cut-throat commercial feuds, a shady ashes scandal and a volatile love triangle. Together, they traverse the Northumberland coast to piece together the truth and catch a killer before anyone else gets hurt, or worse...

show.name: The Northumbria Mysteries
show.summary:
Set against the sweeping Northumberland coastline and its surrounding market towns, the series centres on an unlikely crime-solving duo.

Joe Ruby, a jack-of-all-trades whose life has been shaped by mistakes, regrets and missed opportunities, alongside Oxford-educated DI Rose O'Connell, a rarefied intellectual, a deep thinker with a brilliant mind and an ice-cool disposition.

In a classic odd-couple pairing, Joe and Rose combine their talents as they frustrate, confound and ultimately surprise one another while unravelling a series of compelling crime mysteries.

body.name: Episode 6
body.summary:
When a burnt-out delivery van is discovered on a quiet rural road, Rose and Raj are met with a grim crime scene: a charred body in the passenger seat and no sign of the driver. Sifting through the ashes, they uncover a bizarre assortment of clues, including a melted key fob, rusted gardening tools and a bottle of imported Polish vodka.

Tracking down the van's insured drivers leads them to Kelly Prudham, a tight-lipped agency cleaner, and Scott Smith, a devoted widowed father missing since the previous evening. Is Scott the vanished driver, or is he the unidentified victim in the passenger seat? Kelly claims concern for Scott's young daughter Chloe, yet she stonewalls every question. However, Rose's sharp eyes spot an identical bottle of Polish vodka in Kelly's flat, indicating that Kelly may have a dangerous motive for concealing her and Scott's recent movements.

Meanwhile, Joe can't resist probing into the mystery. Dragging Brother Christopher along, he snoops around the crime scene and dives into Scott's past. Relying on his sharp human intuition and feeling somewhat aligned with this man who seems to be struggling as a father, Joe forms a bold theory about Scott's whereabouts. But his covert search goes sideways, stranding Joe and Christopher in a perilous predicament deep in the Northumbrian moors.

With time running out and danger escalating, Rose, Joe and Raj must pool their findings to identify the burnt remains, track down the arsonist and expose the motive behind the blaze before the truth burns out completely.

body.name: Episode 7
body.summary:
When James Irving is shot dead in broad daylight in the middle of a bustling market town, the police are left with an inexplicable murder scene. No witnesses saw where the sniper's bullet came from, and there is no clear motive. Assigned to the case, Rose and Raj hit a wall. James was a well-liked man with no obvious enemies, and despite clear CCTV coverage of the square, the killer remains completely invisible.

As media and political scrutiny intensifies, opportunistic county councillor Jeffrey Cecil seizes the tragedy to whip up public hysteria, stoking anti-outsider sentiment and fear. Out of options, Rose turns to Joe. Knowing his military background and his uncanny knack for reading human psychology, she brings him into the investigation, reuniting the pair to crack an impossible case.

The stakes skyrocket when a second shooting occurs in identical, ghost-like fashion. This time, Rose and Raj uncover a critical link: both victims were army veterans. Facing unprecedented pressure from local politicians and journalists, and James's understandingly demanding widow, Marissa, Rose finds herself under a spotlight unlike anything she has handled before.

To trace the military-grade weapon used in the attacks, Joe is forced to approach Ace, whose help always comes with a cost. Turning to such an untrustworthy ally places Joe in a hugely difficult position, but one that's worth it to help Rose. Working against the clock, Rose, Raj and Joe must untangle the connection between these fallen soldiers to expose an elusive sniper before another target ends up in the crosshairs.

body.name: Episode 8
body.summary:
When accountant Robbie Bickell slips out of a pub without paying and vanishes into a taxi, no-one expects his dramatic end. Hours later, as the tide recedes along the ancient pilgrims' way to Lindisfarne, a walker makes a terrifying discovery: Robbie's body, tied to a wooden refuge post. His killer leaves behind a single, cryptic clue - a playing card depicting St Cuthbert, the medieval saint who founded Holy Island's famous monastery.

Assigned to unravel the ritualistic murder, Rose and Raj interrogate everyone linked to Robbie's final hours: the barmaid who poured his last drink, his estranged wife Anna, and a schoolgirl witness who may have seen him entering the taxi.

But as Rose tries to decipher the holy card's deeper meaning, Joe faces his own battle closer to home, when local gangster Ace pays him a menacing visit, holding potentially explosive leverage. Ace knows Rose used public money to fund Joe as an undercover player in Ace's high-roller poker game, an unorthodox move that could destroy her career. He offers a ruthless ultimatum: Joe does his bidding or Rose's career gets ruined. Crushed under the weight of this blackmail, Joe suddenly pulls away from Rose, leaving her baffled by his unprecedented lack of interest in her work.

Compounded by an unexpected visit from her father, Rose finds her focus divided just as Joe reaches a desperate tipping point. Caught in a brutal moral dilemma, Joe must decide whether to betray Rose to protect himself or to walk away from the life he now loves in order to protect Rose. Can he bring himself to come clean with her?

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: River of No Return
show.summary: Adapted from the novel of the same name written by Ma Boyong, the story follows crown prince Zhu Zhanji, who is trapped in Nanjing and caught in a shocking conspiracy. Together with constable Wu Dingyuan, female doctor Su Jingxi, and junior official Yu Qian, he dodges layers of manhunt and travels all the way back to the capital via the Grand Canal within 15 days to receive the imperial edict.

In 1975, the Dearborn High Yellowjackets became the first team in state history to qualify for the Girls' U.S. Soccer Championship Series in Manchester, NH. They never got the chance to compete. Equal parts survival epic, horror story and pitch black coming of age, Yellowjackets tells the story of the (un)lucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Ontario wilderness, chronicling their descent from a friendly, cooperative team to warring, cannibalistic clans. But hidden among the contestants are traitors who will try to deceive and manipulate the rest of the group to grab the ultimate prize for themselves alone, while the others, unaware of who the traitors are, work as a team with the aim of eliminating them from the game. The stakes will be high and will test everyone's ability to juggle a dense web of alliances and betrayals. If at least one traitor makes it to the end of the game he will keep the entire prize money for himself, but if all the traitors are unmasked, the other participants still in the game can divide the prize equally.

A large demolition compensation payment puts the family's old troubles and chronic problems on full display. Sai Duoxi, a domineering and authoritarian father, throws his children's lives into chaos as he fights to preserve his rule over the household. The five pairs of sons and daughters in the Sai family are five different portraits of life. A sudden turn of events then shakes Sai Duoxi's status as "head of the family," while the five pairs of children begin to reconsider the family's generational relationships and confront their own life dilemmas. Ultimately, the Sai family comes to understand that a home is a place of equality and dignity, and that love means family reunion.

show.name: Beautiful Malice
show.summary: A girl from Sichuan, Zhang Zhi'an, moves to South Korea to study abroad and stumbles into an elite chaebol academy — landing in Class F, the lowest tier of the social ladder. Here, everyone lives by a strict code of power drawn along lines of birth and family background, and the whole class is steeped in outright malice. But an airhead is the natural antidote to a schemer: armed with her uniquely Chinese brand of relaxed, unbothered obliviousness, Zhang Zhi'an doesn't just fail to sense the hostility around her — she's far too busy wanting to study to care. Then, one day, she lets slip a glimpse of explosive martial-arts skill that floors the entire class. Slowly but surely, in her own distinctly Chinese way, she begins steering the lost, rebellious students of Class F back toward learning — kicking off a fiery, rule-breaking high-school journey in which she climbs step by step through the academy, turning Class F into a name to be reckoned with.

show.name: Mystery Science Theater 3000
show.summary:
Mystery Science Theater 3000 started as a locally produced television show for KTMA in Minnesota but soon grew in popularity. It moved to Comedy Central (originally the Comedy Channel), then to Syfy. After an eighteen-year hiatus, the crew of the Satellite of Love returned in 2017, airing on Netflix for two seasons. In 2021, the production started its own streaming service, The Gizmoplex, where the riffing of cheesy movies continues. Rifftrax revitalised the series once again in 2026 with four more episodes of the series. 

Over the years, there have been several "test subjects": Joel Robinson, Mike Nelson, Jonah Heston, and Emily Connor along with their robot friends Tom Servo, Crow T Robot, and Gypsy (now GPC) all subjected to bad movies thanks to a host of mad scientists including Doctor Clayton Forrester, his mother Pearl, and most recently Kinga Forrester.
